clauses.clause: When this artifact enters, exile all creature cards with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard until this artifact leaves the battlefield.
clauses.evidence: Trace [cast]: you_fallen (a mana value 2 creature card) 'moves graveyard -> exile ... (until card leaves the battlefield, then back to the graveyard)', you_used (a sorcery) and the opponent's graveyard stay; entry on the opponent's turn the same. The 3-or-less boundary and the return are not shown. Pack A08_1: Walking Corpse (2) and Sparkhunter Masticore (3) exiled, Crypt Lurker (4) and Shock stay, the opponent's creature card stays, no ask. Pack A08_2: when the Idol is put into the graveyard the two cards return to the graveyard.

clauses.clause: {1}{W}, {T}: Until end of turn, you may cast a creature spell from among cards exiled with this artifact without paying its mana cost.
clauses.evidence: Trace [activate [1] from battlefield]: the cost is paid ('mana C-1 W-1', 'card becomes tapped') and nothing else is shown. Pack A08_3: a creature exiled with it is cast for free (every Plains already tapped, no black mana) and resolves; a second exiled creature is not castable this turn (one spell). A08_4: only cards exiled with THIS Idol (not a card exiled by another Idol, not a card exiled elsewhere). A08_5: on a later turn the Corpse is not offered. A08_6: activated on the opponent's turn, a creature spell still cannot be cast then. A08_7/A08_8: 'without paying its MANA cost' waives the mana cost only: Sparkhunter Masticore cast from exile through the Idol still discards a card (the Forest), and with an empty hand no cast is offered (CR 118.9d).
